name: Sticky Password
description_en:
Sticky Password manages passwords, notes and form data with a choice of cloud synchronization, local-network synchronization or no synchronization. That choice is central to its use: users can choose where encrypted vault copies travel, while taking on different backup and device-availability responsibilities.

It offers individual and team licenses, including a Lifetime option for core Premium functionality. A lifetime password-manager license does not make every surrounding service permanent; Dark Web Monitoring has a separate renewal boundary.
description_zh:
Sticky Password 管理密码、笔记和表单数据，可选择云同步、本地网络同步或不同步。这一选择是核心：用户能决定加密保险库副本传往何处，同时承担不同备份及设备可用性责任。

它提供个人和团队许可，含核心 Premium 功能的 Lifetime 方案。终身密码管理许可不代表周边服务永久包含，Dark Web Monitoring 有单独续费边界。

sections.en:
The Windows help guide distinguishes cloud sync and encrypted cloud backup from local Wi-Fi device-to-device sync and no sync. The setting can be changed after installation through the main window or Synchronization settings. Cloud-independent vault transfer is not the same as a fully self-hosted server product.

For a pilot, create a disposable login and edit it on one device, then verify the selected sync route on another. With no sync, separately plan recovery after device loss. With local sync, validate network reachability and the device-specific instructions before assuming a geographically separated device will receive updates. This research did not install clients or observe any transfer.
sections.zh:
Windows 帮助指南区分云同步及加密云备份、本地 Wi-Fi 设备间同步、不同步。安装后可在主窗口或同步设置更改选项。不依赖云的保险库传输并不等同于完整自托管服务器产品。

试点可创建测试登录，在一台设备编辑，再在另一台验证所选同步路径。不同步时需另规划丢设备恢复；本地同步应先核对网络可达性及具体设备指南，不能假设异地设备也会收到更新。本文未安装客户端或观察传输。

sections.title_en: Resetting an account does not recover its database
sections.title_zh: 重置账户不会恢复数据库
sections.en:
The forgotten-password article says the provider cannot retrieve a lost master password. Its documented reset deletes all data tied to the StickyID and is irreversible; keeping the same email can preserve license terms when creating a fresh account. This distinction matters when the cloud contains an encrypted backup that still needs the missing password.

Before moving important credentials, preserve master-password recovery material securely outside the vault and test the intended emergency-access arrangement separately. A synchronization copy is not proof that forgotten-password recovery works. No reset, recovery or cryptographic audit was carried out here.
sections.zh:
忘记密码文章说明厂商无法取回遗失主密码。文档中的重置会不可逆删除该 StickyID 关联的全部数据，以相同邮箱新建账户可保留许可条款。云中虽有加密备份，但仍需已遗失密码时，这一区别尤其关键。

迁移重要凭据前，应在保险库外安全保存主密码恢复材料，并单独测试所需紧急访问安排。有同步副本不能证明可恢复遗忘密码。本文未进行重置、恢复或密码学审计。

sections.title_en: Lifetime core license and renewable monitoring
sections.title_zh: 终身核心许可与可续费监控
sections.en:
The page displays Lifetime at a promotional USD 79.99 versus USD 199.99, with one year of Dark Web Monitoring; renewal of that service is USD 12/year. The annual individual offer displays USD 29.99 versus USD 39.99, while Teams displays USD 29.99/user/year. These are a dated page snapshot, not a guaranteed renewal invoice.

The 30-day trial excludes monitoring in its offer text, but a lower team-monitoring paragraph says it is included during trial and subscription. This internal contradiction needs confirmation. Do not classify a trial as an ongoing free plan or assume lifetime monitoring. Legal license details, checkout taxes and platform-specific feature availability were not reviewed.
sections.zh:
页面显示 Lifetime 优惠 79.99 美元、对照价 199.99，含一年 Dark Web Monitoring，该服务续费每年 12 美元；个人年付显示 29.99、对照价 39.99，Teams 每用户每年 29.99。这只是读取时页面快照，不保证续费账单。

30 天试用的方案文字排除监控，但较低处团队监控段落又称试用及订阅期间包含，存在内部矛盾，须确认。不能将试用归为持续免费版，也不能默认监控终身免费。未核法律许可细节、结账税费及各平台具体功能。
